name: astro-cloudflare-workers-setup
description: Guided, end-to-end setup for an Astro static site on Cloudflare Workers — from an empty folder to a live, auto-deploying site with a custom domain, Workers Builds CI/CD, SEO, security headers, accessibility, and a self-documenting repo — plus an optional second skill that makes the site private with passkey-only sign-in. Built to work for both novices and experienced developers.
